note: *testemunhos* was heard first as accounts of religious experience; with *vossos* it was heard rightly. The price of the cognate.
*preceitos* was listed as an unknown word at each of its places; *decretos* and *justificações* are the options, one touch for the psalm.
*o que dissestes* for the plural *elóquia* (D26): five Latinist majors (118:11, 103, 148, 158, 162), held. *os vossos ditos* and *palavras* are the options (HANDOFF).
*Firmai para o vosso servo o que dissestes*: the singular clause of D16; the Latinist's minor on its past tense is D16's named cost.
*Se a minha meditação não fosse a vossa lei*: a Latinist major held (D24); he wants the indicative *é a minha meditação*.
*por isso odeio*: HANDOFF asked a re-read of *odiei*; draft 18 made it *odeio* and passed the gate.
*o meu auxílio e o meu amparo*: a Latinist major, raised three times, held (D24; HANDOFF). He asks *o meu auxiliador e o meu protetor*.
*está todo em brasa*: the third wording; the blind reader heard *muito ardente* as fervent, and the Latinist rated *fogo muito ardente* critical.
